summary: Added replayable Ry/CNOT preparation circuits for both empirical option-book exposure laws, a clean-workspace zero reflection, and per-power logical gate ledgers separating forward preparation, inverse preparation and controlled gates. Verified state, inverse and Grover equivalence against the dense oracle. Compared the amplitude schedule with equal-call power-zero sampling and connected grid approximation error to preparation size in a new studio case. Explicitly retained CCX as a three-qubit primitive and documented preprocessing and synthesis exclusions.
